howItWorks.title: Three Steps to Create
howItWorks.subtitle: From idea to artwork — simpler than you imagined
howItWorks.step1Desc: Describe the design you want in natural language, or upload reference images. The AI understands what you really mean.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Visdraft analyzes your needs and generates multiple professional design options. Every detail — from color to layout — is carefully considered.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Freely edit any element on the canvas. Once you're happy, export in one click with support for multiple formats.

features.title: Design, Beyond Generation
features.subtitle: Visdraft isn't just a generator — it's your intelligent design partner
features.canvasDesc: Collaborate with AI on an infinite canvas. Start from a simple idea and let AI build a complete design system — layout, color, typography — all WYSIWYG.
features.chatDesc: Not cold command execution. Visdraft understands your design needs, proactively offers suggestions, and iterates toward the best solution through conversation.
features.brandDesc: Upload your brand assets and the AI automatically grasps your brand tone. No matter how much you create, the style stays consistent.
features.editDesc: AI generation is just the starting point. Edit every element directly on the canvas, fine-tuning until you're satisfied.
features.launchSubtitle: Turn your product idea into a launch campaign.
features.launchDesc: Create product visuals, promo videos, and social ads from one brief.
features.seasonalSubtitle: Create timely ads for every big moment.
features.seasonalDesc: Produce campaign concepts and ready-to-publish assets for holidays, sales, and events.
features.productAdsSubtitle: Turn product photos into scroll-stopping ads.
features.productAdsDesc: Generate multiple ad variations for different audiences, formats, and platforms.
features.socialSubtitle: Keep your brand active across every channel.
features.socialDesc: Make short videos, posts, and visuals for TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
features.brandStorySubtitle: Turn your brand direction into creative.
features.brandStoryDesc: Develop a consistent visual style for campaigns, launches, and everyday content.
